AIReviewResponse.title: AIReviewResponse
AIReviewResponse.description:
Response from ``POST /api/projects/{id}/ai-review``.

Attributes:
    project_id: The project.
    run_id: ID of the saved AI review run.
    status: ``clear`` when every program has no concerns, otherwise ``concerns``.
    model: The Gemini model that produced the review.
    files: One comparison per program, each with ``matches`` and ``concerns``.
        Every finding has ``cobol_lines``, ``python_lines``, and ``detail``.

AnalyzeResponse.title: AnalyzeResponse
AnalyzeResponse.description:
Response from ``POST /api/projects/{id}/analyze``.

Has the ``FileCounts`` fields plus:

Attributes:
    project_id: The analyzed project.
    run_id: ID of the saved analyze run.
    status: ``analyzed`` after COPY/CALL/PERFORM dependency discovery.
    dependencies: Resolved COPY/CALL/PERFORM links (matched file or paragraph).
    unresolved: COPY/CALL/PERFORM names that could not be resolved.
    programs: Per-program field and paragraph summaries (what to convert together).

AnalyzedField.title: AnalyzedField
AnalyzedField.description:
One data item from a program's WORKING-STORAGE / LINKAGE / copybook data.

Attributes:
    level: COBOL level number as text (``01``, ``05``, ``88``, …).
    name: Data-item name.
    picture: ``PIC`` clause when present (``None`` for group headers / 88).
    value: ``VALUE`` clause text when present.
    occurs: ``OCCURS n`` count when present.
    line: 1-based source line of the declaration.
    parent: For level-88 conditions, the elementary field name above them.
    section: ``WORKING-STORAGE``, ``LINKAGE``, etc., when known.

AnalyzedParagraph.title: AnalyzedParagraph
AnalyzedParagraph.description:
One PROCEDURE DIVISION paragraph (header location, no body text).

Attributes:
    name: Paragraph name.
    start_line: 1-based line of the paragraph header.
    end_line: 1-based last line before the next paragraph (or end of procedure).

ConvertFilesResponse.title: ConvertFilesResponse
ConvertFilesResponse.description:
Response from ``POST /api/convert``.

Attributes:
    download_id: Use this in ``GET /api/convert/{download_id}/files/{name}``.
        The file is kept in memory until the API restarts.
    files: One result per uploaded file, in upload order.

ConvertResponse.title: ConvertResponse
ConvertResponse.description:
Response from ``POST /api/projects/{id}/convert``.

Attributes:
    project_id: The converted project.
    run_id: ID of the saved convert run; ``GET .../runs/{run_id}`` returns it again.
    status: ``review_required`` if any file has notes, otherwise ``draft``.
    files: One result per program.

ConvertedFile.title: ConvertedFile
ConvertedFile.description:
A ``PythonDraft`` plus the names of the input and output files.

Attributes:
    source_name: The COBOL file name, such as ``PAY.cbl``.
    python_name: The generated file name, such as ``PAY.py``.

ConvertedProjectFile.title: ConvertedProjectFile
ConvertedProjectFile.description:
A ``ConvertedFile`` from a project, as saved in its convert run.

Attributes:
    source_file_id: ID of the COBOL file it came from.
    status: ``draft`` or ``review_required``; never verified here.

CreateProjectRequest.title: CreateProjectRequest
CreateProjectRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /api/projects``.

Attributes:
    name: 1 to 100 characters, and not only spaces.

DependencyLink.title: DependencyLink
DependencyLink.description: A resolved COPY, CALL, or PERFORM link from an analyze run.

DescribeResponse.title: DescribeResponse
DescribeResponse.description:
Response from ``POST /api/projects/{id}/describe``.

Attributes:
    project_id: The described project.
    programs: One plain-language summary per program file.
    shared_data: Which files and copybooks those programs share.

EquivalenceCheck.title: EquivalenceCheck
EquivalenceCheck.description:
One program's COBOL-versus-Python stdout comparison from a verify run.

Attributes:
    source_name: COBOL file name.
    python_name: Generated Python file name.
    equivalent: Whether both sides ran and stdout matched exactly.
    cobol_stdout: Output from GnuCOBOL.
    python_stdout: Output from the generated Python.
    error: Failure detail when not equivalent.
    diff: Unified diff from the COBOL output to the Python output; empty when they match.

FileEquivalenceResponse.title: FileEquivalenceResponse
FileEquivalenceResponse.description: One program's COBOL-versus-Python comparison in a verify response.

FileKind.title: FileKind
FileKind.description: What a project file is, decided by its extension.

FileReview.title: FileReview
FileReview.description:
Gemini's comparison of one program with its generated Python.

Attributes:
    source_name: COBOL file name.
    python_name: Generated Python file name.
    matches: Behaviors the model could justify from both sources.
    concerns: Lines the rules could not prove, or behavior that may differ.

LineFinding.title: LineFinding
LineFinding.description:
One AI observation, tied to COBOL and Python line numbers.

Attributes:
    cobol_lines: 1-based lines in the COBOL source. Empty if none apply.
    python_lines: 1-based lines in the generated Python. Empty if none apply.
    detail: One sentence on why these lines match or need a human look.

LoginRequest.title: LoginRequest
LoginRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /api/auth/login``.

Attributes:
    email: The account email.
    password: The account password. A mismatch is the same 401 as an unknown email.

LoginResponse.title: LoginResponse
LoginResponse.description:
Response from ``POST /api/auth/login``.

Attributes:
    token: Signed JWT. Send it as ``Authorization: Bearer <token>``.
    token_type: Always ``bearer``.
    expires_in: Seconds until the token expires.

ProgramSummary.title: ProgramSummary
ProgramSummary.description:
Per-program inventory from an analyze run (fields + paragraphs).

Attributes:
    source_name: Project file name (for example ``BANKMAIN.cbl``).
    program_id: ``PROGRAM-ID`` value when present.
    fields: Data items in declaration order.
    paragraphs: Procedure paragraphs in source order.

ProjectListResponse.title: ProjectListResponse
ProjectListResponse.description:
Response from ``GET /api/projects``.

Attributes:
    projects: Every project, newest first.

ProjectResponse.title: ProjectResponse
ProjectResponse.description:
A project and its files, without its runs.

Attributes:
    id: The project's ID; use it in every ``/api/projects/{id}`` route.
    name: The project name.
    created_at: When it was created (UTC).
    files: Its files, in upload order.

ProjectSummary.title: ProjectSummary
ProjectSummary.description:
One project in the project list: no file contents and no runs.

Has the ``FileCounts`` fields plus:

Attributes:
    id: The project's ID.
    name: The project name.
    created_at: When it was created (UTC).
    last_run: The most recent run without its files, or ``None`` if no
        step has run yet.

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description:
Body of ``POST /api/auth/register``.

Attributes:
    email: Stored lowercase. A second sign-up with the same email is 409.
    password: 8 to 128 characters, with a letter and a number. Not stored.
    display_name: 1 to 100 characters after spaces are removed.

Run.title: Run
Run.description:
A ``RunSummary`` plus what the step produced.

Where a field is typed ``RunSummary``, Pydantic writes only the summary
fields, so run lists stay small.

Attributes:
    files: The Python generated by a convert run; empty for other runs.
    checks: Equivalence results from a verify run; empty for other runs.
    dependencies: Resolved COPY/CALL/PERFORM links from an analyze run.
    unresolved: COPY/CALL/PERFORM names that could not be resolved.
    programs: Per-program field and paragraph summaries from an analyze run.
    reviews: Per-program AI findings; empty for other runs.

RunKind.title: RunKind
RunKind.description: Which pipeline step a run recorded.

RunStatus.title: RunStatus
RunStatus.description: The outcome of a run, or of one converted file.

RunSummary.title: RunSummary
RunSummary.description:
A record that one pipeline step ran on a project.

Attributes:
    id: Number within its project, in run order: ``"1"``, ``"2"``, ...
    kind: Which step ran.
    status: Its outcome.
    created_at: When it ran (UTC).

RunsResponse.title: RunsResponse
RunsResponse.description:
Response from ``GET /api/projects/{id}/runs``.

Attributes:
    project_id: The project.
    runs: Every run, oldest first, without generated files.

SourceFile.title: SourceFile
SourceFile.description:
One file stored in a project.

Attributes:
    id: Number within its project, such as ``"1"``. Never reused.
    name: File name, such as ``PAY.cbl``.
    kind: Program, copybook, or data.
    content: The file's text.

UnresolvedDependency.title: UnresolvedDependency
UnresolvedDependency.description: A COPY, CALL, or PERFORM whose target could not be resolved.

UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse
UploadResponse.description:
Response from ``POST /api/projects/{id}/files``.

Attributes:
    project_id: The project the files were added to.
    files: Only the files added by this request.

UserResponse.title: UserResponse
UserResponse.description:
An account with no password and no password hash.

Attributes:
    id: Account ID.
    email: Lowercase email.
    display_name: Name shown in the header.
    created_at: When the account was created (UTC).

VerifyResponse.title: VerifyResponse
VerifyResponse.description:
Response from ``POST /api/projects/{id}/verify``.

Attributes:
    project_id: The project.
    run_id: ID of the saved verify run.
    status: ``verified``, ``mismatch``, or ``not_verified`` (runner off or unreachable).
    passed: ``True`` if every program matched, ``False`` on mismatch,
        ``None`` if nothing was compared.
    note: Short human-readable summary.
    files: Per-program equivalence details, one per main program (programs
        that another program calls run as part of their caller).
